subject: Civil Engineer application (SEEK 95798711), Marc Masarate
email_body:
Dear Ryan,

I'm applying for the Civil Engineer role at Allen Price advertised on SEEK (advert 95798711). Your name is listed for enquiries, so I wanted to reach you directly.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in Australia, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a project-in-charge engineer and then a field engineer. I'm based in Melton with a White Card, driver's licence and my own transport, and I have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I'm open to discussing relocation to the South Coast.

Your roles cover roads, landform and stormwater design for land development, which is the work I trained in. My site experience is just under a year and I haven't used DRAINS, MUSIC or Civil Site Design yet, so I'd be learning those with your team.

Could we have a short call about the role? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

letter.company_line: Allen Price delivers civil design for land development and infrastructure projects from its Wollongong, Kiama and Nowra offices.
letter.subject: Civil Engineer, Wollongong (SEEK 95798711)
paragraphs: Please accept my application for the Civil Engineer role at Allen Price. Preparing road, landform and stormwater designs for land development projects, and working alongside town planners and surveyors, is the kind of work I want to build my career in.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in Australia. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D against Australian Standards, and lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries and designed around existing services. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I reviewed structural and architectural drawings and checked work against project requirements, and as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I carried out inspections and quality checks and coordinated with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers.

I hold an Australian driver's licence with my own transport and a White Card, and I have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I live in Melton and am open to discussing relocation to the South Coast. My site experience is just under a year and I have not yet used DRAINS, MUSIC or Civil Site Design, so I would learn those with your team.
I have attached my resume and would welcome the chance to talk about the role.
